Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent. •Recovery loops:quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota. •Multi-repo via submodules:projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar. •Stack:Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/Type Script (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações HTTP com Jira/Git Hub via curl + retry policy.O que você vai fazerManutenção do core (40%) • Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática. • Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário. • Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento. • Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue). • Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva.Evolução de agents e rules (35%) • Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist). • Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho. • Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex:@dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146). • Criar/refatorar skills. • Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B).Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%) • Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, Open AI CLI, Gemini CLI, Deep Seek direct). • Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: Deep Seek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação). • Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve. • Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient; expandir cobertura). • Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria.O que esperamos de vocêStack técnica — obrigatório •Bash/Shell avançado e Linux— você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de (( e porque importa. •Node.js / Type Script— escreve TS com strict mode, entende quandonãousar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS). •Git e Git Hub avançado— cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, Git Hub Actions workflows. •Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos— você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o quenãofazer\" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou.Experiência • 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção. • Pelo menos 1 ano comagentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMsem ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\". • Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\". • Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time).Mentalidade •Determinismo > magia.Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável. •Forensics sobre intuição.Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese. •Documentação executável.Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta. •Empatia por agente.Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar.Diferenciais • Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, Open AI Agents SDK, Lang Graph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes. • Já implementou ou manteve sistemas deretry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breakerem integrações com APIs externas instáveis. • Já trabalhou commonorepos via submodules(nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs. • Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks). • Experiencia comDev Ops em servidores Linux dedicados(não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves. • Familiaridade comconventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico (feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick). • Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam.Benefícios • VR/VA – Flash Benefícios • Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde • Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco • Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4 Life • Day Off de Aniversário • Total Pass • Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

Na área de iluminação comercial, a SolutionMall oferece suporte na análise de requisitos, seleção de produtos, acompanhamento de RFQs, comunicação com fornecedores e coordenação de cotações. Esta função é adequada para profissionais com experiência em vendas B2B, iluminação LED, produtos elétricos, projetos de construção, distribuidores de iluminação, canais de empreiteiros, RFQs ou vendas de soluções baseadas em projetos. O foco principal será identificar necessidades de iluminação, desenvolver relacionamentos com clientes, promover produtos e soluções adequados, apoiar RFQs e cotações e ampliar oportunidades de projetos de iluminação. Construir relacionamentos com distribuidores de iluminação, distribuidores de produtos elétricos, empreiteiros, consultores, empresas de engenharia, proprietários de projetos, gestores de instalações e equipes de compras. Promover as soluções de iluminação da SolutionMall para aplicações internas, externas, industriais, arquitetônicas, municipais, cênicas e especiais. Acompanhar requisitos dos clientes, listas de iluminação, especificações, RFQs, cotações, orçamentos e planos de entrega. Apoiar a seleção de produtos e a definição de soluções para escritórios, escolas, hospitais, hotéis, shopping centers, armazéns, fábricas, estradas, parques, túneis, fachadas, auditórios e espaços públicos. Coordenar com equipes internas, fornecedores, clientes e demais partes envolvidas para confirmação técnica, preparação de cotações e acompanhamento de projetos. Coletar informações de mercado sobre demanda, produtos mais procurados, preços, concorrentes, canais, preferências dos clientes e oportunidades de projetos.  Requisitos Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência em uma ou mais das seguintes áreas: Iluminação comercial Iluminação LED Iluminação interna Iluminação externa Iluminação industrial Iluminação pública Iluminação arquitetônica Iluminação cênica Iluminação à prova de explosão Controle inteligente de iluminação Produtos elétricos Desenvolvimento de distribuidores Canais de empreiteiros Acompanhamento de RFQs Coordenação de cotações Vendas B2B baseadas em projetos Capacidade de compreender necessidades dos clientes, cenários de iluminação, seleção de produtos, especificações de projetos e requisitos de RFQ. Boa capacidade de comunicação e desenvolvimento de clientes, distribuidores, empreiteiros, consultores, proprietários de projetos e equipes de compras. Experiência com projetos de iluminação, sistemas elétricos, projetos de construção, modernização para economia de energia ou aquisição baseada em projetos será considerada uma vantagem. Capacidade de comunicação em inglês será considerada um diferencial. Conhecimento de outros idiomas será valorizado.  Qualificações Preferenciais Rede existente de clientes ou canais nas áreas de iluminação comercial, produtos elétricos, construção ou gestão de instalações. Experiência com distribuidores, empreiteiros, consultores, integradores, empresas de engenharia ou clientes finais. Conhecimento de produtos de iluminação, aplicações, especificações técnicas, preços e processos de cotação. Os detalhes serão discutidos durante o processo de entrevista. Como se Candidatar Envie sua candidatura com uma breve descrição da sua experiência em: Iluminação comercial Iluminação LED Distribuição de produtos de iluminação Canais de produtos elétricos RFQs Cotações Desenvolvimento de projetos de iluminação  Você também pode enviar seu currículo atualizado para:  Assunto do e-mail: Application: Business Development Manager – Commercial Lighting

title: FinCrime Analyst - Brazil
description:
Nova vaga disponível para FinCrime Analyst - Brazil em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Revolut  People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role  Our Financial Crime team blends regulatory expertise with data-driven thinking to make sure our products meet legal and policy requirements and deliver real value to customers. In a fast-moving, digital environment, they stay one step ahead by finding smart, scalable ways to prevent financial crime. We're looking for a FinCrime Analyst to review and get to the bottom of customer issues. You’ll collaborate with colleagues, both internally and externally, to solve cases and deliver an outstanding customer experience. To support our 24/7 coverage, this role may include night and weekend shifts, which are fully compensated. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing  Conducting due diligence reviews of customers, businesses, and transactions using internal systems, screening tools, and external sources Reviewing and investigating alerts generated by sanctions, PEP, KYC/KYB, and transaction monitoring systems to identify potential risks Performing financial crime risk assessments to detect suspicious activity, including money laundering, terrorist financing, fraud, and other predicate offences Escalating potential compliance, sanctions, or financial crime issues to relevant escalation teams, MLROs, or Compliance leadership Validating customer and corporate documentation to ensure customer due diligence (CDD) and onboarding requirements meet internal policies and regulatory standards Conducting risk-based reviews of individuals and entities (e.g., directors, shareholders, UBOs) to identify regulatory, fraud, and compliance risks Analysing customer profiles, nature of business, and transactional activity to identify inconsistencies, red flags, or deviations from expected behaviour Collaborating with internal stakeholders, including Support, Compliance, and Product teams to resolve complex cases and improve procedures  What you'll need  A bachelor's degree or equivalent Fluency in English and Portuguese (C1+ level) 2+ years of FinCrime experience Familiarity with investigative methodologies evidenced by use of analytical tools (e.g., spreadsheets, filters, pivots, network charts) A willingness to work a variety of shifts, including nights and weekends Critical thinking skills Impeccable attention to detail The ability to multitask, prioritise, and work well under pressure  Nice to have  A degree in law or STEM subject A professional certification (ICA or ACAMS) Fluency in other languages  Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team. Important notice for candidates:  Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles. • Only apply through official Revolut channels.  We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment. • Always double-check the emails you receive.  Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain. We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.  If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately. By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Product Manager - Sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Product Manager - Sênior em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Sobre a posição no jogo  Estamos em busca de pessoas Product Managers Sênior  com forte visão de negócio e capacidade de execução para liderar a evolução de nossos produtos digitais. No GRUPO SBF, nossos PMs atuam na interseção entre estratégia, dados, tecnologia e experiência do usuário, transformando desafios complexos em soluções digitais escaláveis. Esta é uma banca de talentos estratégica  para posições que impactam diretamente a eficiência operacional e a geração de valor do grupo. Buscamos profissionais que joguem em alto nível, que saibam navegar por ambientes ambíguos e que queiram liderar transformações reais no ecossistema do esporte. Objetivos estratégicos do produto  Orientação a Resultados e Negócio:  Conectar a estratégia do produto diretamente aos KPIs críticos do negócio, garantindo eficiência, escalabilidade e retorno sobre o investimento. Decisões Baseadas em Dados:  Estabelecer uma cultura analítica forte, utilizando dados quantitativos e qualitativos para embasar o roadmap, priorizações e hipóteses. Inovação e Eficiência com IA:  Explorar e integrar o uso de Inteligência Artificial e automações para otimizar processos internos, melhorar a experiência do usuário e acelerar o time-to-market. Alinhamento de Stakeholders:  Traduzir necessidades de diversas áreas (comercial, operações, marketing, etc.) em produtos digitais funcionais, garantindo uma adoção real e sustentável pelas frentes de negócio.  Responsabilidades  Definir e desdobrar a visão, estratégia e o roadmap do produto, alinhando a tecnologia às necessidades de crescimento da companhia; Conduzir processos de Discovery contínuos com usuários, clientes e áreas de negócio não-digitais, transformando dores reais em soluções de software; Atuar com forte viés analítico, definindo, monitorando e comunicando KPIs claros de produto e impacto no negócio; Avaliar cenários de Build vs. Buy (desenvolvimento interno vs. contratação de fornecedores), considerando custos, prazos e escalabilidade; Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de Engenharia, Design, Dados e parceiros de sistemas corporativos (como SAP e plataformas de mercado); Gerenciar o ciclo de vida do produto com metodologias ágeis, garantindo a qualidade das entregas e a melhoria contínua; Liderar e influenciar stakeholders transversais de forma clara, estruturada e colaborativa, garantindo o alinhamento de prioridades complexas.  Requisitos Obrigatórios  Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior  em contextos de varejo, e-commerce, ecossistemas complexos ou produtos digitais de alta escala; Forte capacidade analítica e de negócio , com histórico comprovado de tomada de decisão baseada em dados e métricas financeiras/operacionais; Vivência prática em processos de discovery profundos com stakeholders de diferentes perfis (técnicos e não-técnicos); Experiência sólida na gestão, priorização e refinamento de roadmaps e backlogs usando metodologias ágeis; Comunicação clara, articulada e excelente habilidade de negociação e gestão de expectativas com múltiplos stakeholders.  Diferenciais Desejáveis  Experiência ou interesse prático na aplicação de soluções de IA (Inteligência Artificial) , LLMs ou automações avançadas no dia a dia do produto; Experiência com sistemas corporativos e integrações complexas (ex: ERPs como SAP, CRMs, ferramentas de Analytics); Domínio de ferramentas analíticas (SQL, Power BI, Tableau ou similares); Histórico em projetos de transformação digital ou reestruturação de produtos legados.  O que define sucesso nessa posição  Alta taxa de adoção e engajamento das soluções lançadas pelas áreas usuárias; Impacto mensurável nos principais KPIs de negócio atrelados ao produto; Capacidade de entrega consistente e redução do lead time entre a descoberta da dor e o valor entregue; Sólido alinhamento e alto índice de confiança estabelecido com os principais stakeholders.  Bora movimentar o esporte!!

Role Overview  We are looking for a highly skilled Ad Designer who can both design and video edit performance-driven creative for paid media channels. This role is responsible for turning strategy into high-converting visual assets across Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms. You will work closely with our Marketing team to test, iterate, and scale creative that drives revenue — while emphasizing our premium brand positioning. Key Responsibilities    Performance Creative Development  Design static and motion ad creatives for Meta, TikTok, and other paid platforms Develop multiple creative variations per concept (hooks, angles, CTAs, layouts) Execute rapid testing cycles based on performance data Translate growth briefs into high-quality, on-brand ad assets Develop creative aligned to seasonal campaigns    Video Editing & Motion  Create short-form video ads (9:16, 1:1, 4:5, 16:9 formats) Edit UGC into performance-optimized paid ads Add captions, motion graphics, overlays, callouts, and performance hooks Optimize pacing and retention for the first 3–5 seconds Re-cut and repackage winning content into multiple variants Incorporate voiceover, testimonial layering, and sound design where needed    Performance & Iteration  Review performance metrics weekly with Growth team Identify winning hooks, formats, angles, and messaging Produce new variants based on data (not just aesthetics) Help build a scalable creative testing system Maintain an organized creative library with tags by angle, hook, and performance  🧠 Creative Strategy Collaboration  Collaborate with Marketing team on creative briefs Repurpose UGC into paid formats Support product launches with creative concept development Contribute to creative ideation sessions  Required Skills & Experience  3–5+ years in performance-focused creative design Strong portfolio of paid social and digital ad creative Strong understanding of Meta ad formats Advanced proficiency in: Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, Premiere Pro, After Effects) CapCut / similar short-form editing tools Experience designing for DTC brands (premium preferred) Ability to balance brand integrity with performance urgency Strong organizational skills Comfortable with fast iteration cycles  What Makes You Exceptional  You understand the difference between brand creative and performance creative. You know how to design urgency without feeling “cheap.” You can turn one piece of UGC into 10 different ad variations. You think in hooks and testing frameworks. You care about typography, layout, and visual hierarchy. You move quickly but thoughtfully.  Why This Role Matters  At our stage, creative is the lever. Media buying is only as strong as the creative behind it. This role directly impacts revenue growth, efficiency, and scalability. You will play a central role in helping Carepod reach our next major milestone.   How to apply  Please submit your resume in English as part of your application.

title: Customer Support Specialist - Brazil
description:

Job Description: Customer Support Specialist Who We Are:   Shoplift, an American software startup based in NYC, helps thousands of e-commerce merchants like Kith, Liquid Death, Olukai, and more, acquire online customers efficiently and profitably by optimizing their online storefronts with our intelligent, automated experimentation and personalization platform.  Your Role:  As a Customer Support Representative at Shoplift, you'll be the daily face of Shoplift to thousands of merchants. You'll own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls, diagnosing problems accurately, responding with empathy and clarity, and seeing every case through to a confident close. You're the first person a merchant turns to when something isn't working, and the quality of that moment shapes how they feel about the entire platform. You'll do more than close tickets. You'll build real product and platform expertise, recognize the patterns behind recurring issues, and feed what you learn back to Product, Engineering, and Customer Success so the whole experience gets better. When you spot a merchant at risk or an opening to grow, you'll route that signal to the right account owner fast. Why this role matters:   Storefront optimization is no longer a \"nice-to-have\"; it's becoming table stakes for ecommerce success. Merchants are trusting Shoplift with decisions that directly move their revenue, and every support interaction either reinforces or erodes that trust. Support isn't a cost center here. It's a direct input to retention, satisfaction, and growth, and you're on the front line of it. Responsibilities:  Support delivery:  Own the resolution of merchant issues across chat, email, and calls. Diagnose accurately, respond with empathy and clarity, and see each case through to a confident close. Escalate complex, high-impact, or time-sensitive issues to the Support Team Lead promptly and with clear, complete context so nothing stalls in handoff.  Service quality and consistency:  Ensure every response reflects Shoplift's standards for accuracy, tone, and helpfulness. Use support macros correctly and flag any that are outdated or misaligned with current product behavior so they can be corrected quickly. Deliver the consistency merchants expect regardless of who picks up their ticket.  Product and platform expertise:  Maintain deep, current knowledge of how A/B testing, experiment setup, and CRO workflows function for merchants day to day, and understand enough of the underlying Shopify environment to reason about issues in context. Product fluency is what separates a good answer from a resolution that actually moves the merchant forward.  Cross-functional collaboration:  Partner with Product and Engineering by reproducing issues cleanly, documenting them clearly, and surfacing recurring patterns that point to deeper fixes. Meet support SLA targets across priority levels and keep tickets moving on the \"waiting on us\" side of any dependency.  Retention and expansion signal:  Recognize retention risk and expansion opportunity in the course of support conversations, and route those signals quickly and accurately to the relevant CSM or account owner. Reinforce merchant trust and satisfaction in every interaction.  Continuous improvement:  Strengthen self-serve and AI-enabled support by identifying gaps in documentation, macros, and help content, and recommend improvements to tools, training, and enablement based on what you see in the queue. Support the ramp of new teammates by sharing knowledge and modeling the service standard  What We’re Looking For:  Must-haves:  Shopify ecosystem experience. You've worked in or around the Shopify platform and understand how merchants operate within it, including apps, themes, and the merchant admin. You can speak a merchant's language from day one. Direct-to-consumer fluency. You understand the DTC and ecommerce world, how online brands think about conversion and growth, and the pressures merchants face. This context lets you prioritize correctly and respond with credibility. Proven front-line support experience delivering high-quality service across chat, email, and phone. Strong verbal and written proficiency with English, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly and empathetically to non-technical merchants. Strong diagnostic instincts and a bias toward full resolution over deflection. Comfort working at pace in a high-growth environment where processes are still being built.  Nice-to-haves:  Familiarity with A/B testing, experimentation, or conversion rate optimization (CRO). Prior experience supporting a SaaS or B2B software product. Experience with support tooling such as ticketing systems, macros, and AI-assisted support workflows. Light technical exposure (HTML/CSS, JavaScript) or familiarity with analytics platforms (Google Analytics, GA4, Segment).

title: Investidor
description:
Empresa está contratando Investidor em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

PROPOSTA EXECUTIVA: YUMMI Status do Projeto: 100% Concluído e Pronto para Rodar O Cenário Atual Muitas startups buscam investimento para tentar construir uma ideia. Nós fizemos o oposto. A Yummi já superou a fase mais arriscada de um negócio de tecnologia. O software está totalmente desenvolvido, testado e validado. Buscamos um parceiro estratégico e financeiro focado exclusivamente em colocar o produto no mercado e acelerar a atração de clientes. O Problema do Mercado Atualmente, os donos de estabelecimentos vivem um caos operacional. Eles sofrem com a fragmentação, precisando contratar, pagar e gerenciar de três a cinco sistemas diferentes para rodar o negócio, como frente de caixa, delivery, financeiro e cardápio digital. Para piorar, as ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial genéricas do mercado falham, erram pedidos em horários de pico e causam prejuízo. A Solução Yummi A Yummi elimina essa bagunça unificando todas as funções essenciais em uma única plataforma centralizada, intuitiva e robusta. Nós corrigimos as falhas das tecnologias comuns, aplicando uma Inteligência Artificial lapidada e integrada de forma nativa. O comerciante elimina custos com múltiplos softwares, reduz despesas fixas e gerencia o negócio inteiro com um único login. Risco Zero de Desenvolvimento O maior medo de um investidor em tecnologia é o atraso ou o fracasso no desenvolvimento do software. Na Yummi, esse risco não existe. O produto mínimo viável está cem por cento concluído e funcional. A infraestrutura está pronta e testada para suportar alta demanda de acessos. Nosso foco atual é zero por cento em programação e cem por cento em marketing e vendas. Destinação do Capital e Custos Base Todo o capital aportado será direcionado estrategicamente para gerar tração imediata e receita. Oitenta por cento (80%) do recurso será aplicado diretamente em Marketing e Aquisição de Novos Clientes, utilizando estratégias agressivas de tráfego pago no Google e Meta Ads, ações locais e canais comerciais para acelerar a entrada de novos usuários na plataforma. Os vinte por cento (20%) restantes serão mantidos como Contingência e Operação, garantindo a estabilidade absoluta de servidores como AWS ou Firebase e o suporte técnico inicial para que os novos clientes tenham uma experiência impecável. Por que a Yummi é um Investimento Confiável? Como a Yummi centraliza toda a operação do cliente, o custo de mudança para ele é muito alto, o que garante uma taxa de cancelamento extremamente baixa e retenção prolongada. Além disso, o modelo é altamente escalável: os custos de servidor são previsíveis e, conforme a base de clientes cresce, a margem de lucro líquido aumenta exponencialmente. Oferecemos total transparência, com relatórios mensais detalhados de crescimento, usuários ativos e faturamento. O motor já está construído e ligado. Só precisamos do combustível para o marketing.

title: Legal Analyst
description:

Legal Analyst   Description  We are seeking an experienced Legal Analyst  to support a growing U.S.-based law firm specializing in commercial transactions and corporate legal matters. This 100% remote position will work directly with attorneys to draft, review, and negotiate a wide variety of legal agreements while assisting with corporate governance, due diligence, legal research, and select mergers and acquisitions (M&A) matters. The ideal candidate is highly organized, fluent in English (written and spoken), experienced supporting U.S.-based attorneys or businesses, and comfortable managing multiple legal projects simultaneously with minimal supervision. Responsibilities  Draft, review, edit, and redline commercial agreements, including Master Service Agreements (MSAs), Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs), Statements of Work (SOWs), service agreements, purchase agreements, and amendments. Prepare first drafts of legal documents using attorney guidance and firm templates. Conduct legal research related to commercial, corporate, contract, and business law matters. Assist attorneys with corporate governance matters, entity formations, annual filings, and corporate record maintenance. Support mergers and acquisitions activities, including due diligence, document organization, disclosure schedules, and transaction closing checklists. Review contracts for legal, commercial, and business risks and summarize key issues for attorney review. Coordinate contract execution, signature collection, and final document management. Maintain organized electronic legal files and document management systems. Track transaction timelines, deadlines, and attorney action items across multiple client matters. Assist with client correspondence and preparation of legal deliverables. Support process improvements and standardization of legal templates and document workflows.  Requirements  Education & Licensure:  Law Degree (LL.B., J.D., or regional equivalent) from an accredited law school. Active bar admission/license to practice law  from Brazil, or a relevant international jurisdiction is strictly required. Experience:  5–10 years of post-qualification experience (PQE) practicing corporate law, either within a reputable law firm or as in-house counsel. M&A Expertise:  Proven track record of actively working on M&A transactions and drafting/negotiating complex purchase agreements. Language:  Native or bilingual fluency in English (written and spoken)  is mandatory, with the ability to draft complex legal documents in English. U.S. Context:  Deep experience supporting U.S.-based companies, cross-border transactions, or working under common law principles. Negotiation Skills:  Strong commercial acumen with a proven ability to redline contracts effectively and negotiate directly with opposing counsel.  Technical Requirements  Document Management:  Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word (specifically tracking changes and document comparison), Excel, and Google Workspace. Legal Tech:  Experience utilizing Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platforms (e.g., Ironclad, DocuSign, ContractWorks) and digital signature workflows. Collaboration:  Comfortable operating in agile, remote environments using tools like Teams, Slack, and Zoom. Innovation:  Experience leveraging AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, specialized legal AI) to drive legal operations efficiency and streamline workflows.

description:

The role requires native fluency and the capacity to deliver 20 to 40 hours of recorded content monthly on a per-hour paid basis. Voice Over Artist (Brazilian Portuguese)  About Pocket FM  Pocket FM is the world’s leading audio storytelling platform, reaching over 200 million listeners across more than 20 countries. We combine human creativity and innovative technology to create immersive audio series enjoyed by millions of listeners worldwide. As we expand our Portuguese content library, we are looking for talented, professional Brazilian Voice Over Artists  to join our global network of creators. Role Overview  As a Freelance Voice Over Artist, you will bring complex characters and gripping stories to life in serialized audio fiction. You will collaborate remotely with our production, writing, and quality teams to deliver highly engaging, emotionally authentic performances for long-form series. This is a remote, contract-based freelance opportunity offering a consistent monthly pipeline of work for a long-term collaboration.  Requirements  Native Fluency: Native Brazilian Portuguese speaker with the ability to perform in Neutral Brazilian Portuguese.  Versatility & Acting Chops: Strong acting, dubbing, or storytelling skills, with the ability to portray diverse characters across a wide range of ages and emotional profiles.  Proven Experience: Background in voice acting, dubbing, audiobook narration, audio drama, or podcasting.  Studio Setup: A professional home recording studio environment with a high-quality microphone and reliable, high-speed internet.  Capacity: Availability to record and deliver up to 20-40 hours of recorded content per month, while maintaining weekly delivery schedules.  Collaboration: Openness to taking performance direction and participating in necessary retakes/feedback sessions.   Nice to Have  Familiarity with basic audio editing and file management  Experience working remotely with production teams   Engagement Details  Contract Type:  Freelance / Independent Contractor Location:  Remote (Work from your own studio) Compensation:  Paid monthly on an hours delivered basis.  How to Apply :  Please fill in  What happens after you apply?   Our Casting & Production Process : Here is a look at our step-by-step collaboration pipeline: 1.Internal Evaluation:  Our production team will carefully review your voice demos, studio specs, and portfolio to see if your vocal profile matches our upcoming projects. 2.Show Casting & Voice Testing:  If your profile fits, we will invite you to a voice test for the specific audio series we are casting. This helps us ensure your performance aligns perfectly with the character's vision. 3.Contract & Legal Alignment:  Once selected for a show, we will finalize a freelance legal agreement. This contract will clearly outline the voice usage rights for the series and formalize our agreed monthly payment terms. 4.Calibration & Onboarding:  Before the official recording begins, we will run a brief calibration session. This ensures your studio's audio mastering levels match our technical delivery standards for a seamless workflow. 5.Production & Monthly Deliveries:  Recording begins! Our long-form audio series typically span 150 to 300 hours  in total. We partner with you for the long haul, expecting a steady delivery of 20 to 40 hours of recorded content per month  until the series is complete.

title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Nova vaga disponível para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About Us  Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens. At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact. Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide. Role Overview  As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives. Key Responsibilities  1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)  Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script. Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards. Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.  2. Script-to-Audio Alignment  Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression. Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.  3. Technical & Creative Accuracy  Check audio for: Voice clarity and consistency Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness Background noise or distortions Timing and pacing issues Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files Grammatically incorrect words/sentences Physical noise of voice artist Abrupt cut / jerk Sibilance Fumble / mumble  4. Vendor & Artist Coordination  Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.  Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.  5. QC Documentation & Tracking  Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level. Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content). Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.  6. Pre-Release Quality Checks  Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform. Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.  7. Cross-Team Collaboration  Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality. Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.  8. Process Improvement  Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties. Key Responsibilities  FX Trading & Liquidity Management Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS), LATAM (ARS, BRL, MXN) and/or Asian (IDR, VDN, etc.)  on markets. Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks  across relevant regions. Hedging Strategy & Risk Management Design and implement FX hedging strategies  to manage corporate or client-driven exposures. Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools  where relevant. Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization . Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.  Trading Infrastructure & Systems Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including: Automated hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation systems Smart order routing Pricing and risk management tools Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers  via APIs or FIX protocols. Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .  Market Development Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners  across emerging markets. Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs  and support new corridor launches. Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure  supporting global payments and settlement flows.  Requirements  Experience 5–10+ years of FX trading experience  in Emerging Markets. Strong experience trading African currencies , such as: Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP Experience working at: Global banks EM FX trading firms Payment / fintech companies Crypto exchanges or market makers Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .  Technical Expertise Deep understanding of: FX market microstructure in illiquid markets  NDF markets and offshore hedging  Capital controls and FX regulatory frameworks  Hands-on experience building or optimizing: FX trading systems  Hedging engines  Liquidity aggregation platforms  Familiarity with FIX connectivity, API-based trading systems, and algorithmic execution .  Skills Strong quantitative and analytical capabilities. Ability to operate in high-volatility and fragmented liquidity environments . Strong network within EM FX liquidity providers and OTC trading desks . Excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.  Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting high-volume cross-border payment flows or treasury operations . Experience trading EM FX through both traditional banks and alternative liquidity sources . Familiarity with stablecoin / crypto liquidity markets in emerging economies . Background in building or scaling FX market-making operations . Strong analytical and problem solving skills Ability to operate across global teams and fast paced environments  Vision & Mission  OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

Head of Risk (Crypto) (Brazil-based)  About the Company:  We are one of the world's earliest and most established digital asset platforms, serving tens of millions of users across global markets. Consistently ranked among the top exchanges worldwide, we support a comprehensive suite of trading and wealth management products across thousands of digital assets. With thousands of employees spanning key financial hubs globally, we operate with a remote-first, high-autonomy culture that attracts talent who thrive in fast-moving, intellectually demanding environments. We are building the financial infrastructure of the next era of the internet — and we're looking for exceptional finance professionals to help shape it. The Role:  We are in search of a business-oriented Head of Risk (Crypto) to lead the overall risk management function for our Brazil entity. This role focuses on end-to-end risk management across trading, financial crime, and product risk, while ensuring the company operates within its defined risk appetite while actively supporting business growth. Unlike traditional compliance-heavy roles, this position is about risk ownership: identifying exposures, calibrating tolerance, and driving real-time control execution. We're looking for someone who understands that well-designed risk frameworks are a business enabler, not a brake. We welcome candidates with a strong crypto or digital asset background. We are equally open to risk leaders from traditional financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, or payments companies who bring deep, transferable expertise and a genuine appetite to operate in a more dynamic, high-growth environment. What You'll Do:  Establish and lead the company's enterprise-wide risk management framework, covering trading and market risk, product risk, financial crime risk, and operational risk. Define, review, and continuously optimise the risk appetite framework in alignment with overall business strategy. Monitor risk activities to ensure alignment with internal risk policies, business objectives, and applicable Brazilian regulatory expectations, and other relevant regulatory authorities. Partner with senior leadership and the Board to embed risk-informed thinking into strategic decision-making. Build and enhance risk control mechanisms across transaction monitoring and risk indicators, market surveillance controls, and product risk assessment frameworks. Identify and stay ahead of emerging risks in trading, product design, and operations, and lead mitigation strategies. Strengthen internal control systems and drive effective risk governance across the organisation. Support the company's ongoing regulatory engagement and risk governance as Brazil's digital asset regulatory framework continues to evolve.  What We're Looking For:  10+ years of risk management experience within crypto, financial institutions, capital markets, fintech, payments, or digital asset businesses. Deep expertise in enterprise risk management, including risk appetite frameworks, governance, and internal controls. Strong understanding of trading, transaction, and financial crime risks, with the ability to balance effective risk management against commercial objectives. Ability to translate risk frameworks into practical controls and work cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Operations to implement them. Proven track record operating at or reporting to Executive Committee and Board level. Strategic thinker with the confidence to influence senior stakeholders and embed a strong risk culture across the organisation spanning across operational, market and liquidity risk. Expert understanding of Brazilian regulatory expectations relating to financial institutions and digital asset service providers. Crypto or digital asset experience is strongly preferred, but we also welcome candidates from traditional financial services with strong transferable risk expertise and a genuine interest in the digital asset sector. Functional knowledge of digital asset or digital token listing processes is preferred.

title: Reiseberater:in Brasilien (Freelance, vor Ort)
description:

Travel Buddies  Wir sind ein Team, das in den Destinationen lebt, die wir verkaufen. Unsere Buddies in Kuba, Vietnam und Namibia planen jede Reise selbst und betreuen die Gäste vor Ort. Das ist der Grund, warum Leute bei uns buchen. Wir arbeiten direkt mit lokalen Partnern, ohne Zwischenhändler. DRSF-zertifiziert, Trustpilot 4,9/5, bekannt aus WELT und Handelsblatt. Jetzt bauen wir Brasilien auf. Du wärst die erste Person dafür. Was du machst  Du lebst in Brasilien und kennst das Land aus deinem Alltag, deinen Freundschaften, deiner Arbeit. Du hast zwei Aufgaben bei uns: Du sprichst mit deutschsprachigen Reisenden, die bei uns einen Beratungstermin gebucht haben. Du verstehst, was sie wollen, und planst mit uns gemeinsam ihre Reise — Routen, Unterkünfte, Erlebnisse. Du bist die Stimme aus Brasilien, wir bauen das Angebot daraus. Wenn deine Gäste in Brasilien ankommen, bist du ihr Ansprechpartner. Per WhatsApp, im Call, manchmal persönlich. Du löst Probleme, wenn der Inlandsflug nach Salvador gestrichen wird oder die Pousada überbucht ist. Du organisierst Begegnungen, die im Reiseführer nicht stehen — die Köchin für deine Moqueca, den Jangadeiro mit seinem Segelfloß im Nordosten, den Musiker in der Roda de Samba, den Capoeira-Lehrer, den du persönlich kennst. Du arbeitest 1:1 mit deinen Gästen. Dein Job ist, sie über dein Netzwerk und deine Geschichte mit dem Land zu verbinden. Was du mitbringen musst  Du lebst seit mehreren Jahren in Brasilien. Mit Alltag, Freundeskreis, festen Strukturen. Deutsch auf Muttersprache- oder C1-Niveau. Die Beratung läuft auf Deutsch. Du hast eine eigene Geschichte mit dem Land. Warum bist du gekommen, was hält dich. Du arbeitest selbstständig und bist gut erreichbar — per WhatsApp und im Video-Call.  Was zusätzlich hilft  Portugiesisch-Kenntnisse Englisch fließend Erfahrung in Tourismus, Hospitality oder Beratung Ein eigenes Netzwerk an Hotels, Pousadas, Drivern, Köchen Vertrautheit mit CRM, Google Workspace, WhatsApp Business Zugang zu Menschen, die einen Gast persönlich beeindrucken: Köche, Musiker, Fischer, Capoeira-Lehrer, Flussbootskapitäne im Amazonas  Was wir bieten  Freelance-Vertrag mit flexiblen Stunden. Als Nebentätigkeit gedacht für jemanden, der ohnehin im Land lebt. Vergütung auf Stundenbasis plus Boni für Buchungen und gute Bewertungen. Du baust eine Destination von null auf und prägst, wie wir Brasilien machen. Ein eingespieltes Team im Rücken: Buchungen, Verträge, Tools, Versicherung. Du machst das, was nur du kannst. Langfristige Zusammenarbeit über Jahre.  Eine Frage in deiner Bewerbung: Welchen Ort oder welche Begegnung in Brasilien könntest du möglich machen, die ein Tourist allein nie findet?

title: Engenheiro de IA Sênior
description:
Empresa está contratando Engenheiro de IA Sênior em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Sênior  para assumir a manutenção e a evolução contínua do Plataforma Agents de IA  — nosso framework de orquestração de agentes de IA que automatiza ciclos completos de desenvolvimento de software (refinement → dev →security → QA → deploy) em nossos projetos reais, em produção. Esta não é uma vaga de \"treinar modelo\" nem de \"fazer prompt em chatbot\". E engenharia de plataforma com foco em confiabilidade, observabilidade e auto-recuperação  de agentes autônomos rodando 24/7 em produção, escrevendo código de desenvolvimento, fazendo git push, abrindo PRs, mergeando em omolog, fazendo cherry-pick para produção. O que é o Plataforma Agents de IA  Para você decidir se a vaga te interessa, precisa entender o que vai manter: • Orquestrador:  Le as issues (Jira), identifica issues prontas pra cada stage, dispara agentes (Claude/OpenIA/Gemini/DeepSeek) com contexto rico, valida o resultado, posta comentario na issue, e avanca o status. Roda em servidores Linux, com auto-update. • Agentes (@dev, @qa, @sec, @devops, @pm, @po, @sm, @analyst, @architect, @data-engineer, @ux-design-expert):  cada um com persona, authority matrix definida, skills executáveis e Gates de qualidade. • Rules:  Mais de 60 regras formais que governam o comportamento dos agentes — desde naming conventions até anti-hallucination validation em 7 camadas. Cada rule nasce de um bug real anonimizado em produção e tem detector regex + caso aplicação por agent. • Recovery loops:  quando um stage falha (CI quebra, conflict de cherry-pick, working tree dirty, autocompact thrashing), o orquestrador detecta deterministicamente e redispara o agente em --mode=ci_recovery com contexto enriquecido. Cap de tentativas, anti-oscilação, escalada pra humano quando esgota. • Multi-repo via submodules:  projetos clientes tem 2 a 30+ sub-repos. Vertex orquestra cherry-pick coordenado, dependency promotion cross-issue, working-tree auto-recovery, validação de paridade de coverage Sonar. • Stack:  Bash 5+ (nucleo), Python, Node.js/TypeScript (CLIs auxiliares), gh CLI, jq, integrações HTTP com Jira/GitHub via curl + retry policy. O que você vai fazer  Manutenção do core (40%)  • Manter e evoluir fix de bugs, refatorações controladas, redução de complexidade ciclomática. • Garantir que retry policies (Git, PM API, autocompact, recovery loops) continuem determinísticas e sem custo desnecessário. • Manter as integrações com Jira API (ADF, webhooks, transitions, comments via helper canônico) funcionais frente a mudancas de schema/comportamento. • Operar e melhorar o sistema de telemetria (dashboards de custo por agent/stage/issue). • Diagnosticar incidentes em produção (cliente reporta \"agent crashou em loop\", \"PR criado no repo errado\", \"deploy não promoveu\") e fechar com case study anonimizado + nova rule preventiva. Evolução de agents e rules (35%)  • Criar e refinar rules quando bugs sistemicos forem detectados — cada rule nova segue o template canônico (detector regex, aplicação por agent, caso real anonimizado, antipatterns, checklist). • Calibrar prompts dos agents para reduzir alucinação, scope creep, falsos positivos e ciclos de retrabalho. • Manter o agent-authority.md consistente quando authorities mudarem (ex: @dev ganhou ownership de PR contra homolog em v2.0.146). • Criar/refatorar skills. • Medir impacto de cada rule nova (redução de ciclos de retrabalho, custo USD por issue, leakage rate de bugs Categoria A vs B). Integrações com LLM CLIs (25%)  • Manter compatibilidade com mudanças de breaking change dos provedores (Claude Code, OpenAI CLI, Gemini CLI, DeepSeek direct). • Avaliar e integrar novos providers/modelos quando custo-benefício mudar (ex: DeepSeek-Reasoner para recovery loops, Haiku para classificação). • Otimizar custo: identificar stages onde modelo menor resolve. • Implementar fallbacks quando um provider está em outage (ja existe retry transient; expandir cobertura). • Trabalhar com tokenização, context windows, autocompact thrashing detection — entender as falhas reais de cada modelo, não a teoria. O que esperamos de você  Stack técnica — obrigatório  • Bash/Shell avançado e Linux  — você e confortável lendo e escrevendo 500+ linhas de bash com set -euo pipefail, traps, subshells, file locks, jq, awk, sed, heredocs, parameter expansion avançada. Não tem medo de poll.sh. Sabe diferenciar ( ) de ((  e porque importa. • Node.js / TypeScript  — escreve TS com strict mode, entende quando não  usar Node (ex: lógica de orquestração crítica fica em bash justamente porque e mais previsível que async JS). • Git e GitHub avançado  — cherry-pick com -m 1, submodules, gh pr create/merge/edit/list --search, git revert, git rebase --autosquash, resolução de conflicts nao-triviais, branch protection rules, GitHub Actions workflows. • Prompt engineering aplicado a agentes autônomos  — você já calibrou prompts em produção, sabe que \"diga ao modelo o que não  fazer\" raramente funciona, entende o efeito de exemplos few-shot vs zero-shot, e já debugou ao menos uma vez porque um agente está \"alucinando\" um PR que não criou. Experiência  • 5+ anos de engenharia de software produzindo sistemas em produção. • Pelo menos 1 ano com agentes autônomos / orquestração de LLMs  em ambiente real (não bootcamp, não side project) — você sabe a diferença entre \"rodou no demo\" e \"rodou em prod 24/7 sem humano\". • Histórico comprovado de manter sistemas legados com debt técnico — você não quer \"reescrever do zero\". • Inglês técnico fluente para leitura/escrita (documentação, issues, comentários de código em inglês obrigatórios; comunicação verbal pode ser PT/EN/ZH dependendo do time). Mentalidade  • Determinismo > magia.  Você prefere uma regex feia em bash que sempre funciona a um ML model elegante que falha em 5% dos casos. Em orquestração de agentes, 5% de falha = produto inviável. • Forensics sobre intuição.  Antes de propor solução, você lê o log, o diff, a issue real do cliente. Não inventa hipótese. • Documentação executável.  Quando você cria uma rule nova, ela tem detector regex que pode rodar em CI. \"Documentei em texto\" não basta. • Empatia por agente.  Você consegue ler um prompt de 8k tokens e identificar onde o modelo vai se confundir, por que, e o que ajustar. Diferenciais  • Experiencia com Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph ou frameworks de orquestração equivalentes. • Já implementou ou manteve sistemas de retry policy + backoff exponencial + circuit breaker  em integrações com APIs externas instáveis. • Já trabalhou com monorepos via submodules  (nao apenas Nx/Turborepo) e entende os trade-offs. • Contribuições open-source em projetos relacionados (CLIs, dev tooling, agent frameworks). • Experiencia com DevOps em servidores Linux dedicados  (não apenas k8s/cloud managed): systemd, cron, logrotate, monitoring com ferramentas leves. • Familiaridade com conventional commits, semantic-release, gitflow trifásico  (feature → homolog → main com cherry-pick). • Já escreveu post-mortem público / case study técnico que outras pessoas referenciam. Benefícios  • VR/VA – Flash Benefícios • Assistência Médica – Bradesco Saúde • Assistência Odontológica – Bradesco • Programa de Orientação Pessoal – C4Life • Day Off de Aniversário • TotalPass • Parcerias educacionais (FIAP e Alura)

title: Country Manager- Brazil
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Country Manager- Brazil em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

About VelaFi  At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we help businesses move money across borders faster, more securely, and more efficiently by connecting local banking rails, global payment networks, and leading stablecoin ecosystems through regulated entities across Latin America, Asia, and the United States. Our mission extends beyond payments—we are creating the infrastructure that enables businesses to operate confidently in an increasingly connected world. By combining innovative technology with regulatory excellence, we simplify complex global financial operations while maintaining the highest standards of compliance, security, and reliability. Position Overview  VelaFi is seeking an experienced Chief Executive Officer (CEO) – Brazil  to lead the company's Brazilian operations and serve as the statutory executive responsible for the local VASP entity. Reporting directly to the Global Executive Leadership Team, the CEO will be responsible for the overall leadership, strategic direction, regulatory engagement, commercial growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. This individual will play a critical role in establishing the company's presence in Brazil, leading local market expansion, fostering relationships with regulators and financial institutions, and ensuring compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate combines executive leadership experience, strong commercial acumen, operational excellence, and the ability to lead a highly regulated financial services organization in a fast-growing global fintech environment. The CEO will also play a pivotal role in leading VelaFi Brazil's regulatory establishment, including executive oversight of the BACEN registration process and collaboration on the company's Brazil VASP licensing process, working closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership.  Location  Remote – Brazil  Candidates must reside in Brazil and be legally authorized to work in the country. Periodic travel within Brazil and internationally may be required. Key Responsibilities  Executive Leadership  Lead the overall strategy, growth, and operational performance of VelaFi Brazil. Build and develop the local leadership team and organizational structure. Establish operational excellence while ensuring alignment with global company objectives. Drive execution across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Product functions.  Regulatory & Corporate Governance  Serve as the primary executive representative before Brazilian regulatory authorities. Maintain strong relationships with the Central Bank of Brazil (BACEN) , financial institutions, banking partners, and other regulatory stakeholders. Lead the company's BACEN registration process, ensuring timely execution of regulatory requirements and coordination with internal and external stakeholders.  Provide executive oversight and collaborate closely with Compliance, Legal, and global leadership throughout the Brazil VASP licensing process, supporting regulatory submissions, licensing milestones, and ongoing compliance efforts.  Ensure ongoing compliance with applicable VASP, financial services, and corporate governance requirements. Support ongoing regulatory reporting, licensing renewals, and corporate governance initiatives.  Commercial Growth & Strategic Partnerships  Develop and execute the company's go-to-market strategy in Brazil. Build strategic partnerships with banks, payment service providers (PSPs), fintechs, enterprise customers, and ecosystem partners. Identify new business opportunities and support revenue growth. Represent VelaFi at executive meetings, conferences, and industry events.  Cross-Functional Leadership  Partner closely with Finance, Compliance, Treasury, Product, Operations, Legal, and Commercial teams. Foster collaboration across global teams located in LATAM, APAC, and North America. Drive organizational alignment and operational efficiency across all business functions.  Organizational Development  Recruit, mentor, and develop high-performing teams. Promote a culture of accountability, innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Support workforce planning and organizational scaling as the business grows.  Qualifications  Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Law, or a related field. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of executive leadership experience within fintech, banking, payments, financial services, or related industries. Proven experience leading business operations and organizational growth. Strong understanding of Brazil's financial services and regulatory environment. Experience working with regulators, banking institutions, and executive stakeholders. Experience leading or supporting regulatory licensing, authorization, or registration processes with Brazilian financial regulators (including BACEN or VASP frameworks) is strongly preferred.  Exceptional leadership, communication, and decision-making skills. Professional proficiency in Portuguese and English.  Nice to Have  Experience in fintech, payments, digital assets, stablecoins, or blockchain technology. Experience launching or scaling financial services businesses in Brazil. Existing relationships with Brazilian regulators, financial institutions, and payment providers. Experience working within multinational or global organizations. Experience with cross-border payments and treasury infrastructure. Experience leading or supporting BACEN registration, financial institution licensing, or Brazil VASP authorization initiatives.   Regulatory Requirements (Brazil VASP)  Candidates selected for this position must be eligible to satisfy applicable Brazilian regulatory requirements, including: Be legally authorized to reside and work in Brazil. Possess the qualifications, experience, and professional competence required to perform executive responsibilities. Successfully complete background checks and regulatory due diligence. Be eligible to serve as an executive of a regulated financial institution under applicable Brazilian laws. Have no disqualifying criminal convictions, financial crimes, or regulatory restrictions that would prevent appointment.  Why Join VelaFi?  At VelaFi, we're building the future of global financial infrastructure. As a stablecoin-powered platform, we connect local banking rails, global payment networks, and digital asset infrastructure to enable faster, more secure, and more efficient cross-border money movement. Joining VelaFi means playing a foundational leadership role in establishing our regulated presence in Brazil while helping shape one of the company's most strategic growth markets. You'll work alongside global executive leadership to build a scalable business, lead critical regulatory initiatives, and help create the financial infrastructure powering the next generation of global payments. Guided by our values of Ingenuity, Accountability, Excellence, Care, and a Global Mindset , we empower our leaders to solve meaningful challenges, take ownership, and build lasting impact across global financial markets. Equal Employment Opportunity  VelaFi is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace where everyone has the opportunity to thrive. We make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?  Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.  O diferencial?  Aqui você é mais que um professor.  Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii  com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.  Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?  Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.  Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Presales Solution Architect, OSS

Responsibilities:   Act as the lead OSS solution architect across the full pre-sales lifecycle – from opportunity qualification and technical discovery through proof-of-concept, proposal, and contract award – partnering closely with Sales leadership to shape, qualify, and grow the regional pipeline. Own and orchestrate end-to-end responses to RFx (RFI / RFP / RFQ), including solution design, compliance and traceability matrices, win themes, technical narratives, effort and Bill-of-Materials estimation, assumptions, and risk identification – driving on-time, high-quality, fully compliant submissions. Design and articulate end-to-end OSS solution architectures spanning Service Assurance, Service Orchestration & Fulfilment, Inventory, and closed-loop automation, mapping the Rakuten Symphony portfolio to operator pain points and measurable business outcomes. Position and demonstrate the Service Assurance portfolio – fault, performance, and service-quality management; AI/ML-driven anomaly detection, alarm correlation and noise reduction; automated root-cause analysis; and predictive, proactive assurance – including customer-experience and network-slice assurance for 5G Standalone. Develop solutions, value cases, and demonstrations around SMO (Service Management & Orchestration) and RIC (RAN Intelligent Controller) platforms, including the Non-RT RIC and rApps (R1, A1 interfaces) and the Near-RT RIC and xApps (E2 interface), addressing use cases such as RAN energy savings, traffic steering, QoE optimization, massive-MIMO and interference management, and anomaly detection. Champion network automation and autonomy – closed-loop operations, intent-based and intent-driven management, and the journey toward TM Forum Level 4 autonomous networks – and translate these capabilities into concrete, quantifiable value propositions for customers. Lead technical proofs-of-concept, lab trials, product demonstrations, and solution integration and validation, tailoring demo environments to each customer’s specific use cases, KPIs, and success criteria. Be responsible and accountable for authoring technical solution documents, high-level designs, design proposals, sizing and Bill-of-Materials, and TCO / ROI models that withstand customer and third-party technical scrutiny. Serve as the trusted technical advisor to customers and prospects – running discovery workshops, executive briefings, and technical deep-dives – and manage technical stakeholder relationships from engineering and operations teams up to C-level. Work cross-functionally with internal teams – Product Management, Engineering, Delivery / Professional Services, Commercial, and Bid Management – and with external parties – operators, system integrators, hyperscalers, and O-RAN / ecosystem partners – to assemble winning and deliverable solutions. Generate thought-leadership content – white papers, blogs, reference architectures, and webinars – and represent Rakuten Symphony at industry events and standards / community forums such as TM Forum and the O-RAN ALLIANCE. Stay ahead of telecom market trends – Open RAN, 5G and 5G-Advanced, cloud-native CNFs and Kubernetes, observability and telemetry, GenAI and agentic AI for operations, and the shift toward data-driven, autonomous networks – and bring that insight into customer conversations and internal strategy.  Requirements:  Must-have demonstrable skills & expertise:  Exceptional verbal and written communication, executive presentation, and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value. Proven hands-on pre-sales and solution-architecture experience in the OSS domain for mobile operators and/or telecommunication vendors, including ownership of RFx responses and customer-facing technical engagements. Deep, demonstrable expertise across the Service Assurance domain – fault, performance, and service-quality management, customer-experience management, and AI/ML-driven assurance (anomaly detection, correlation, automated root-cause analysis, and predictive / proactive assurance). Strong working knowledge of network automation and autonomy – closed-loop assurance and orchestration, intent-based operations, and the TM Forum Autonomous Networks framework (Levels 0–5). Familiarity with O-RAN architecture and SMO / RIC platforms, including the Non-RT RIC (rApps, R1, A1), the Near-RT RIC (xApps, E2), and the O1 / O2 management interfaces. Exposure to public clouds (GCP, Azure, and AWS) and to cloud service models (IaaS, PaaS, DBaaS), with an appreciation of hybrid / multi-cloud and O-Cloud deployment models. Working knowledge of TM Forum standards and Open APIs / Open Digital Architecture (ODA), and of data and observability technologies (streaming pipelines, telemetry, and data lakes). Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate virtual, cross-functional bid and solution teams across multiple geographies and time zones, and to manage internal and external stakeholders. Willingness to travel as required.

Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando. *SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH: * A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas. *O QUE PROCURAMOS: * Você será responsável por realizar atendimentos por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Educador Físico , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos. *PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*  Realizar orientação esportiva por vídeo e telefone com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo acolhedor, empático e resolutivo na maioria das orientações de acordo com os objetivos e dúvidas de saúde trazidos pelos beneficiários, respeitando os diferentes gêneros ou grupos etários; Contatar os beneficiários através de orientações telefônicas e/ou chamada de vídeo para aplicação de anamnese esportiva, com o objetivo de identificar a familiaridade do beneficiário com a atividade física e suas limitações/ restrições de saúde bem como necessidades de melhorias nos hábitos esportivos, para realizar um treino focado e personalizado a cada indivíduo, considerando sua condição clínica, hábitos, comportamentos e objetivo do beneficiário; Esclarecer dúvidas esportivas pontuais, conforme demanda trazida pelo beneficiário garantindo a sua satisfação; Elaborar treinos esportivos personalizados, conforme necessidade e objetivo de cada beneficiário e posterior envio ao mesmo através de e-mail, dentro do prazo estipulado para que melhorem a sua saúde e desta forma atinjam os melhores resultados do programa; Realizar acompanhamento esportivo periódico, para checar se o objetivo esperado está sendo atingido e avaliar se há necessidade de desenvolver novo material; Enviar e-mail e/ou sms, whatsapp para verificar a disponibilidade de horário dos beneficiários, com o objetivo de maior assertividade nas ligações e gerar maior adesão ao programa; Ter visão clínica ampla para saber quando e como solicitar suporte junto a equipe multiprofissional (nutricionista, médico e enfermagem), visando o atendimento das necessidades do beneficiário; Registrar todas as orientações e informações (prestadas e coletadas) aos beneficiários e colaboradores da Teladoc Health em sistema eletrônico e/ou planilha de Excel, visando manter atualizada as bases e tratando de forma confidencial, tornando os processos seguros, éticos e legais; Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática centrada na pessoa; Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes; Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética da Educação Esportiva, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.  REQUISITOS  Formação Acadêmica:  Obrigatório: SUPERIOR COMPLETO EM EDUCAÇÃO FÍSICA  EXPERIÊNCIA  Vivência em montagem de treinos e atuação como Personal Trainer.  CONHECIMENTO ESPECÍFICOS PARA A FUNÇÃO  Conhecimentos e Habilidades no Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point).  Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.  COMPETÊNCIAS COMPORTAMENTAIS  Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional. COMPETÊNCIAS TÉCNICAS  Capacidade investigativa; Raciocínio clínico.  Local de Trabalho:  REMOTO *Remuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo. IMPORTANTE:  MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:  Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CREF do respectivo CNPJ ativo. Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em educação física.

The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service. About the Role  We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows. What You'll Do   Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles. Serve  as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated. Build strong, long-term relationships  with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs. Support the end-to-end matching process  by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions. Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities. Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers. Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving. Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties. Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.  What We’re Looking For  At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role. Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.  Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment. Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric. High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information. Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments. Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change. Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach. Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.  Why You Should Join  Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business. No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness. Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :) Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.  Equal Opportunity Statement  At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.
